value.definition: the notes on who Alan is
value.title: All About Alan
value.description: This is the orientation an `/abby` interviewer loads before the first question. Its job is narrow and specific: surface the **unusual, easy-to-miss things** about Alan — the places where a normal-person prior would mislead you — so you don't open cold and don't spend the session re-deriving the architecture.

invariants.statement: The notes are part of Alan rather than a description of Alan.
The notes have no queue of subjects to work through.
A loose end is a finding.
A change here lands without Alan's review.

directives.name: Authorship
directives.act: Never write a claim about Alan he has not made.
directives.warrant: An invented sentence looks like one he said, so it reads as fact and nobody checks it again.
aids: Write what he said, never what it implies.
Mark your own reading and you may write it.

directives.name: Voice
directives.act: Write every note in Alan's first person.
directives.warrant: A third-person note has the same facts, so nothing but the voice shows it is not his.
aids: Convert every sentence, not just what he said.
Your own marked reading stays in your voice.

value.definition: how far into the whole of knowledge Ali has read, node by node
value.title: Learn Everything
value.description: <!-- Where his model thins — the edge located by the probe that set D. Becomes next session's bites. -->

invariants.statement: The outline is the whole of knowledge.
The files on disk are how far into the outline Ali has got.
A node's mastery level is judged by hand.
A node with children is scored at a rung of its own just as a node without children is.
A node's coverage is worked out from the children beneath the node.
A topic names the topic above rather than sitting in that topic's folder.
How far Alan has mastered each part of the map is kept with the part.
A topic's mastery level is written to that topic's page and never told to Alan in any form.
The answers Alan got right and the answers Alan got wrong are told to Alan.

value.definition: the undertakings in Alan's life with scope, a decision, or work left
value.title: My Projects
value.description: The undertakings in my life that have a scope, a decision to make, or work left to do — the house and its envelope, rooftop solar, the garden and where our food comes from, the vehicles, the insurance and the holdings, the second passport, and the vendors everything else rests on. Each section is one undertaking, and holds what I have settled about it and what is still open.

value.definition: how Alan improves his life with what he has to spend
value.title: My Strategy
value.description: This book is where I work out what to improve next and why. It is not a product roadmap. As I put it in the first session: *"This isn't about what I'm trying to build. This is about improving my life."* The scope is my entire life, organised by my six values — faith, health, wealth, learn, love, fun — plus the work of getting better at improving anything at all. The line that names it: *how Alan improves his life with what he has to spend*.
